pylons_vi: 2 tháp một cột (một mặt phẳng dây), cao ≈150 m; dây văng bọc vàng
pylons_en: 2 single-column pylons (one cable plane), ≈150 m; yellow stay sheaths

pylon_custom.description: Single slender rectangular column on the deck centreline, continuing straight and uniform below the deck into the pier (no split, no diamond). One central plane of yellow-sheathed stays in a semi-fan from the upper ~45% of the column. Prestressed-concrete box girder; deck has a gentle vertical crest.

model3d.colour: grey concrete column; yellow stay sheaths
model3d.notes: Single column, straight from pier to top, seen in side photos; yellow stays seen at deck level. Height 150 m total (Wikipedia), ≈100 m above deck.

review: Single post OK but no below-deck shaft and no stay colour
Explicit single shaft to the pier, anchor zone 55–97 m, yellow stays noted
